verdict.overall: No Sunday baseline exists yet for any of these names, so this read compares only today's levels against the previous scan. The biggest moves since then are NVDA, BE and AMAT all falling 6-8% while still trending down, whereas GOOGL's nearest expiry and ZETA's mid-December expiry show magnets sitting right near price, making them the best-aligned ranges for now. Confidence in those setups is only moderate because recent price swings have been large and magnet levels keep shifting, and AVGO's December 9 earnings add extra uncertainty to that stretch.
